author: fishing-island design stage (TIREDWOOD), art for the review page
status: design stage: images are for lab/fishing-review only, not wired into the game
tool: Codex CLI v0.153.4 (`codex exec`, model gpt-6-astra, reasoning effort overridden to low per call), built-in image_gen tool; fish with transparent_background=true; one call per image, no reference images, no edits
command: codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -C <empty scratch dir> -c model_reasoning_effort="low" -o last.txt "<wrapper + prompt>"  (two calls at most at once; the PNG is saved by Codex into the scratch dir and copied to img/originals/)
wrapper:
Use your built-in image generation tool to generate the following image on a genuinely transparent background (transparent_background true). Do not write code to draw it and do not edit any other files.

<prompt>

Then save the generated image as <id>.png in the current working directory.
styleSource: Fish prompts follow client/assets/fish/FISHECO-PROVENANCE.json (same template; only changes: the species block, and the lighting line is "slightly cool, misty pearl-grey cast (northern foggy-island series)"). Loading screen follows client/assets/loading/PROVENANCE.md (general style, jelly characters), signboard follows client/assets/fishsign/PROVENANCE.md; both bent toward pearl fog (#d9d3c9) and a cool grey-silver palette.
verification: Each image was viewed by eye on a flat grey backdrop: correct species, profile facing left, complete animal, no text or props. Original PNG corners are transparent (alpha 0), final WebP corners checked in code (alpha 0).

processing.fish: sharp (Node): crop to alpha>16 bounds plus 1.2% margin, Lanczos downscale to 320 px wide, alpha >=245 set to 255 and <=4 set to 0, WebP quality 90 with lossless alpha
processing.loading: sharp: 16:9 cut from the 1536x1024 original (full width, 864 px high, offset given per file), Lanczos to 1280x720, WebP quality 62
processing.signboard: sharp: left strip 345 px and right strip 425 px of the original kept undistorted (scaled by height), the smooth middle stretched in width, 1024x568, WebP quality 80
processing.originals: PNGs kept in img/originals/ for the review page (1-3.6 MB each); SHA-256 recorded below
